subject: Request: temporary SLA amendment for OrchardPay migration weekend
messages:
From: Sam Chen <sam.chen@orchardpay.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: OrchardPay Legal <legal@orchardpay.com>
Date: 2026-08-12T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Temporary SLA amendment request for migration weekend

Hi Aditya,

We have a planned data-center migration the weekend of Aug 21–22 (cutover window 22:00 Aug 21 to 06:00 Aug 22 PDT). Because a subset of our critical integrations will be in reduced monitoring (third-party tooling handover) during the window, we need Redwood's help to avoid unnecessary incident escalations.

Specifically we are requesting a short-term, one-time amendment to our support response SLAs for OrchardPay during the maintenance window:
- P1 response target: change from 15 minutes to 30 minutes
- P2 response target: change from 2 hours to 4 hours

We also need a named escalation path and confirmed on-call coverage for the window. Procurement/legal asked that any change be documented as an amendment to the existing agreement and returned within 48 hours so they can review before our change freeze on Aug 18.

Attached is our migration runbook for context. Can Redwood provide a proposed amendment and a short escalation ladder we can include in the runbook? If you need to loop in on-call or SRE folks, please cc them.

Thanks,
Sam Chen
Director, Platforms
OrchardPay
[Attachment: migration-runbook.pdf (1.1MB)]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Sam Chen <sam.chen@orchardpay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-12T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Temporary SLA amendment request for migration weekend

Sam — thanks for the heads up and for the runbook. We can support a temporary amendment for that maintenance window.

High level proposal (we will send a draft amendment and a short mutual action plan):
- Window: 2026-08-21 22:00 PDT -> 2026-08-22 06:00 PDT
- Temporary SLOs: P1 response target 30 minutes (from 15), P2 response target 4 hours (from 2) for incidents opened within the window only
- Duration: single maintenance event; amendment expires at 06:01 PDT on 2026-08-22 unless mutually extended
- Escalation: Redwood on-call RT (primary) -> Redwood SRE lead (secondary) -> Redwood CS escalation (final)
- Credit: we can offer a one-time 1% service credit if Redwood misses the amended windows during the maintenance period (subject to standard SLA claim process)

Operational asks from our side:
- Please confirm maintenance times and the exact list of IPs/endpoints that will be affected so we can pre-warm KV caches and enable targeted prefix caching for the affected prefixes.
- Please confirm whether OrchardPay will run a rehearsal; we recommend at least one table-top rehearsal 48 hours before the migration.

I'm attaching a draft amendment and an outline mutual-action-plan (MAP) for your legal and procurement teams. For speed, we can push the amendment to DocuSign once you confirm.

I've cc'd Grace (SRE) and Marissa (CS) to validate on-call coverage and the proposed credit.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Senior Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: proposed-sla-amendment-draft.pdf (32KB)]

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-12T10:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Temporary SLA amendment request for migration weekend (internal)

Quick internal — I can take SRE secondary for the window. I will place a dedicated responder on the rota from 21:00 PDT to 07:00 PDT and add a surge pager for the critical endpoints list once Aditya sends the final list.

Approve the 1% one-time credit. Recommend we also add an explicit fallback policy in the MAP to route requests to the smaller-latency model variant if backend health degrades.

Grace
Grace O'Connor
SRE Lead, Redwood Inference

(Internal note: ensure on-call handover documented in runbook and that the responder has access to OrchardPay's runbook sections.)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Sam Chen <sam.chen@orchardpay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, OrchardPay Legal <legal@orchardpay.com>
Date: 2026-08-13T13:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Temporary SLA amendment request for migration weekend

Sam — attaching the updated amendment and a short MAP that reflects Grace's on-call assignment and the fallback routing we discussed.

Key items in the attached amendment:
- Exact window and tightened scope: applies only to incidents reported against the 4 endpoints in Appendix A during 2026-08-21 22:00 PDT -> 2026-08-22 06:00 PDT
- P1/P2 temporary targets and the one-time 1% service credit if targets are missed
- Escalation ladder (primary: Redwood rapid-response pager + phone; secondary: Grace O'Connor, SRE Lead; reconvene person: Marissa Cole, CS Lead)
- Fallback: automatic routing to low-latency model variant if backend health falls below thresholds (described in MAP)

Next steps: please review and, if acceptable, sign via DocuSign (link below). Legal has 48 hours to respond per your note; we will queue for expedited review on our side.

DocuSign (draft): https://docusign.com/REDACTED-ORCHARDPAY-2026
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890

Attachments: proposed amendment (PDF), mutual-action-plan (XLSX)

Thanks — we can also jump on a 20-minute call tomorrow to walk the runbook if you'd like.

— Aditya
Senior Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: mutual-action-plan.xlsx (14KB)]

From: Sam Chen <sam.chen@orchardpay.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: OrchardPay Legal <legal@orchardpay.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-14T16:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Temporary SLA amendment request for migration weekend

Aditya / team — thank you. OrchardPay legal completed a quick review and the DocuSign is signed. We accepted the 1% single-event credit and the fallback routing language looks good.

We will:
- Run a rehearsal table-top on Aug 19 at 11:00 PDT (invite to follow)
- Provide the final endpoint list for Appendix A by EOD Aug 17

Aditya — please confirm who the rapid-response pager phone number is for the primary during the window and I will add it to our ops channels.

Thanks,
Sam Chen
Director, Platforms
OrchardPay
[DocuSign completed 2026-08-14 16:12 PDT]
